The system operates by first encoding an object into a high-dimensional feature space (manifold), then applying a generative kernel to produce a new image representation. This process leverages spectral analysis for alignment and probabilistic inference for uncertainty handling. Dualities emerge between input/output manifolds and between deterministic and stochastic transformations. Failure modes include loss of object identity during transformation, misalignment in spectral domains, and collapse of probabilistic distributions. These primitives enable robust visual reasoning under varying conditions.
